description: Clears the bold on a thread for YOU, exactly as opening it on screen does: a colleague reading the same shared mailbox keeps their own. Reading a thread with get_conversation does not do this by itself, on purpose: fetching a mail is not the same as having read it. A message arriving after this call turns the thread bold again. To clear the bold on several threads, give conversation_id the list of their ids, in ONE call rather than one call per thread: the answer then lists in "results" the outcome of each thread in the order given ("ok", with its "result" or its "error") and counts "succeeded" and "failed". Each thread passes exactly the checks it would alone, so one refused or out of reach ("not found") leaves the others done, and the call is an error only when none succeeded.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, as list_conversations gives it, or a list of up to 50 ids to do the same to every one of them in a single call.

name: mark_read
title: Mark a thread read
